title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration

meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

Big bros!
Welcome♪

Guh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I know that feeling all too well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Them being here means...
Is this about us becoming ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you are correct.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Allow me to explain once more.
Phoenix Wonderland would like you to become its ambassadors and travel outside of the park to promote it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and you can both rest easy because your park is in good hands! We promise not to disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But there is one question I'd like to ask before we proceed. Promoting the park does seem necessary, but why make us ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Initially, we were going to use social media as a promotional platform, but now you wish to have us travel outside of the park to promote it. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Ah, that's because we've changed our target demographic.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Fortunately, your little stunt helped attract the younger generation of guests we were after.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Which is why we've decided to set our sights on those living in other parts of the country.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This park is at the heart of Shibuya, so it is able to attract many guests from within the city. However, we rarely ever see guests traveling great distances to visit.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Compared with other parks, our IP share is on the low side. As a result, we don't have a reliable way of attracting guests from other parts of the country.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Partnering with Riley Entertainment remedies some of these issues, but we've decided not to rely so much on existing IPs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
And you wish to make us the faces of the park because of the success we found through social media.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Indeed. Rumors of how you're all high school students have even begun spreading, which has only added to your fame.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Today, we'd like to relay the details of yesterday's meeting, as well as where your first stop will be.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fantastic! So the first stop on my road to stardom has already been decided!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!!
And?! Where do we get to go?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, your first destination will be Phoenix Ocean Resort.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Phoenix Ocean Resort?! The five-star hotel...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Phoenix Hotel & Resort being an Otori Group subsidiary would make things quite a bit easier for us as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why do you know all that, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I decided to look up what I could about the Otori Group while I was coming up with ideas for our last show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A five-star resort would be the perfect stage for a star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel like people who go to fancy resorts aren't really the same as the people who like going to amusement parks...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
That shouldn't be an issue.
We're interested in not the hotel-goers but those coming to visit the beach.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Ocean Resort has an open-air Beach Stage that already attracts a lot of visitors due to it being a sort of public amphitheater.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We would like you to put on a show that is not only family friendly, like the ones you are already doing, but also appeals to a wider audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
I can't wait to see the Beach Stage...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I came across some information regarding this stage. Apparently, it's literally built where the sea meets the sand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... We should be able to include some effects that we normally don't get to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! A show by the sea!
Yay!! Cannonball!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, will all of you settle down a little? Try not to forget that you're ambassadors for this park.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We know!
We promise to give you the best show possible!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You're scheduled to perform for three days. One performance in the morning and one in the evening each day for a total of six times.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Next, regarding what facilities will be available to you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't believe we're staying at the hotel and performing there for three days...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought they were just gonna have us appear as guests for small events or local festivals and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Can we really help promote the park...? Doing shows outside of the park is probably gonna feel really different compared to normal...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you, Nene? You seem concerned...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure what's on your mind, but I'm certain that it's nothing you need to be afraid of...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've already succeeded in putting on a show that hundreds of guests got to see and helped change the course of Phoenix Wonderland's future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Traveling about to perform shows should feel like nothing at all to you at this point, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We managed to pull off something that crazy, so we should be fine even if we're somewhere that's completely new to us.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Again, your audience will include both children and adults, so in terms of what to perform, we'd like you to do something light and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As long as you meet those prerequisites, the rest will be up to you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
But no funny business, got it?
We can't have you pulling another one of your stunts...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Funny business...?
I believe that depends on your definition of the word funny...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're already planning something, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter. It is settled! We will perform a light and cheerful show that visitors of all ages can enjoy while promoting Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we'll show everyone just how great Wonderlands×Showtime is at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We promise to make everything super fun and bring back as many guests as we can!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Good. We'll be counting on you, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So why don't we get started by coming up with some show ideas? Any thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! We get to go to the beach this time, so why don't we do a show about us being fish on an undersea adventure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The sea, huh? What about pirates?
We could bury some treasure on the beach and dig it up during our performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, everything we need for a pirate show does seem to be in place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is there anything you'd like to do, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The sea...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a tad old-fashioned, but the Little Mermaid might be nice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Little Mermaid? That's also a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you like the Little Mermaid, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I saw a rendition of it when I was little, and I can still remember how amazing the lead actress was at singing... I doubt I'll ever forget it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's the reason I decided to start performing in shows and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That was such a long time ago. Back then, I...)

rows.Line: But if I wish to meet him, I must go on land... The thought alone terrifies me...

rows.Line: (Going on land must be really scary for her since she's lived in the ocean her whole life...)

rows.Line: (It's like when we moved into our new house. That was really scary for me too...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Rui said he'd be my friend, but I'm not sure the other kids at school will...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Going to a new school's really scary too...)

rows.Line: No, I mustn't let my fears get the better of me...

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Line: Yeah. She lives in the United States now and has been performing in shows all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unfortunately, you don't get to see her in Japan much anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But she's scheduled to come back this year, so I'm really looking forward to seeing her again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's very exciting news.
Hold on... Isn't she supposed to perform at a venue near the Otori resort?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Does that mean we can all go see Nene's hero together?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That'd be nice but...
She isn't scheduled to perform until after we're gone, so I don't think we'll be able to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww... Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But you know what, Nene, I feel like we should choose the Little Mermaid after hearing your story!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After just that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm with her as well. It's the perfect show for a stage by the sea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We even have access to a romantic beach that can serve as the stage for when the Little Mermaid meets her man.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then the Little Mermaid it is! Wait, oh no!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In the fairytale version, isn't the Little Mermaid supposed to pass away in the end...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True... That means it's technically a tragedy, which would be the opposite of what we should be performing as ambassadors...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we simply pay homage to the Little Mermaid...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pay homage to her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We can think of a new story that's based on the Little Mermaid we all know and love.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since it's so famous, we should be able to make adjustments to it rather easily while still being accessible to any children that may be in the audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Line: Ah, I heard some rumors that one of the merfolk lives far off in the strait and makes these strange potions. Why don't we ask him for some help?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Seriously? There's no way someone living way out there by themselves isn't shady...

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Just play along for one, will you? Otherwise, you'd be locked in here playing video games all day, right?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: C'mon, let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
W-Wait..!
Why aren't you listening to me?!

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line:
Haha!
This is pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: Yeah, let's stick around a bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome!
It's been decades since anyone's come to visit me!

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line: I hear that you seek a potion that will give you human legs. Here, drink this♪

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
*Gulp*... *Gulp*...!
It's not as bad as I imagined.

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Whoa, look!
My tail's glowing!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Huh? This stuff actually works...?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
What the...?!
We've grown legs, but they're covered in scales!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: They're half fish...?

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line: Ah, that didn't quite do it, I see. How about this one...? Wait, this may've been the one for octopus legs...

rows.Speaker: Meroctopus
rows.Line:
Oh, but you can have this.
Drink it when you're in desperate trouble. I would refrain from using it otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Are any of your potions actually safe to use?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Finally, we made it to a human settlement!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
This is what they call a 'city'?
There's so many big buildings!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we have to keep drinking these potions every hour to keep our legs, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Yes, we know!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Hm? What's this? Is it edible? It's shaped like a fish, but has some kind of black substance inside...

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
Nom... It's so yummy☆
It's so warm and sweet! I've never had anything like this before!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Have you two forgotten that it's not safe out here...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But they seem to be enjoying themselves, so maybe it was worth the trip...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Oh, these games look fun too.
I didn't even know the humans have this many games in their city...

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid's Voice
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Merprince's Voice
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Huh?
They got caught?! How...?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Oh no...! Don't tell me they forgot to drink their potions and lost their legs...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: The humans that took them away looked really scary too...! What do I do?! Even if I did try to rescue them, I'll just end up getting caught too...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I still have that weird potion! The one for when we get into really big trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: This is terrifying... But I have to save them before something awful happens to them!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wh-What just happened to me?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that right now... I have to figure out a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Okay!! Let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa! Where'd this gust come from?! Was it that giant fan over there?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Look! It's like Mech Mermaid's really flying!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Hang on, you guys...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see our show today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be eagerly awaiting your arrival at Phoenix Wonderland, so please make sure to come and visit sometime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-Night tickets are also available!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our nighttime spectacles are full of wonderful illuminations, so please don't miss out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come have some with us at Phoenix Wonderland, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: That park does shows like this? That's pretty cool.

rows.Speaker: Tourist
rows.Line: I used to go there all the time when I was a kid, but it might be nice to go now since it's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Our show actually made them want to visit Phoenix Wonderland...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our first performance was a big success.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to shorten the show and add in some effects that involve air and water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So am I! Let's keep this up and knock our afternoon performance out of the park!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
All that's left for today is to clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Robo-Nene needs to be recharged when I get back to the hotel too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so glad our first day as ambassadors went so well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Our story ended up being much happier compared to the Little Mermaid I saw when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But our version seemed to make everybody smile, so I can't really ask for more.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get back to the stage and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Such a beautiful voice...
My heart's starting to race for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait...
No, it can't be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No way...!!
Hehe. The beach really never disappoints. I feel like I can sing forever here!
It'd be nice to go for a swim, but I forgot to bring a bathing suit. Maybe I can dry my clothes on the sand since it's so warm out...

Hm...?
Oh, hello there. Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Are you...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yuka Kazamatsuri...?!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What's Yuka Kazamatsuri doing in a place like this...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I really want to talk to her but... What should I do?! I'd hate to interrupt if she's in the middle of practice or something...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Geez... I'm so nervous, I'm getting drenched in sweat...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Again, can I help you?
You've been staring at me for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...!
I... Uh, th-that is...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I like your outfit. It's very cute.
You look just like a mermaid.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I, um...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was so busy cleaning up that I forgot to take this thing off...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Wait, it sounded like somebody was putting on some kind of performance just now too... Were you by chance a part of that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes! Yes, I was!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I, uh... I work as a cast member for an amusement park called Phoenix Wonderland, and my troupe performed here today as its ambassadors...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You're a cast member for an amusement park? That must be quite a bit of fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
But more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you doing in a place like this, Ms. Kazamatsuri? I thought you weren't supposed to return to Japan until much later...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, you know who I am?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course!
I... I've been a huge fan since I was little...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You are? Really?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I never imagined that I'd meet one of my fans way out here.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I was actually just practicing for my performance for that return to Japan you just mentioned, and staying here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize that...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I promise to go and see your show!
I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
Good luck to you too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe that I'm talking to you right now, Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just that... You're the reason I decided to try to become an actress, Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Because of me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes! My dream is to become an actress who can touch people's hearts by singing just like you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your performance in the Little Mermaid ten years ago is still one of my absolute favorites!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
The Little Mermaid from ten years ago?!
Hehe. That really takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That was actually the first time I landed the lead for a show. I managed to win the part but still didn't have much experience.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But really I'm glad that you liked my performance so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really did! I joined a children's theatre group right after that to learn how to sing like you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There were some points where I felt like giving up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But now, I'm doing shows at one of the stages in Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Hehe. It's almost as if us meeting like this isn't just a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: By the way, how long are you here for?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Us? Well, we're here for three days, so until the day after tomorrow, and we're doing two shows each day at 11 am and 4 pm.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Then I might just be able to catch your last performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Do I need to buy tickets for your show?
If so, I'd like to buy some right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-N-No, that won't be necessary!
It's free to begin with and making you go out of your way to buy tickets doesn't seem right...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Oh, then I should be able to head straight over after I'm done practicing. By the way, your name is...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-Nene!
My name is Nene Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to your show, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Neneee! Where are you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Ah, that must be your friends.
Break a leg tomorrow, okay?
If you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we'll do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aha, there you are!!
Nene, I just finished cleaning up so I decided to come and get you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do, Emu...?!
She's coming to see our last show...!! What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-W-Wah?!
N-Nene, please! Try to calm down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You actually talked to her?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, they say truth is stranger than fiction.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene, that's so amazing.
What did you talk about?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I told her that I've been a big fan since she performed as the Little Mermaid and how we'll be doing our show for a couple more days.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's coming to see our show, right♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No way!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes way... She said she'll try to catch our last performance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, that's great!
What an incredible opportunity! We get to perform for your hero!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Our show's going to make her smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!! It's gonna be super duper maximum wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's do a quick debrief to make sure tomorrow goes even better than today! I'm sure we all found some things challenging being away from home like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I believe we can make the final scene more dramatic by having a slightly stronger fan creating wind for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna make a bigger splash with everyone during the last dance scene too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can always count on the three of them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They were willing to go with my idea, so I need to keep doing everything I can for them too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I want more people to come and visit our park. I want the audience and Ms. Kazamatsuri to smile and laugh. As ambassadors...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's do our absolute best...!
Beach Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Day two was also a great success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The crowd went all the way to the back too! A lot of them even decided to buy advance tickets for Phoenix Wonderland♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed, they did. And as long as we keep this up, our final performances should go swimmingly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we should also be careful not to let our guard down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. I'll make sure to charge Robo-Nene... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where'd she go? She was right here just now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, there she is!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
No, I don't wanna go home yet!
I wanna keep playing on the beach!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
We can't stay here forever.
But if you want to stay that much, we can just leave you here.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: No!!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Konnichi-wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Is that a robot...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The beach is a place that's full of fun and wonderment, like a really exciting show, so it is sad to leave it behind.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: But in time, that sadness will turn into anticipation and even more wonderful memories the next time you visit.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The beach can't say this, so I'll say it in its place... See you again!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Hahaha...!
You're funny, Ms. Robot!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Next time, huh...?
Yeah, we should come again next year.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Yay!
Bye bye, Ms. Robot!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Bye bye.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not just us. Robo-Nene also wants everybody to go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing☆
Nice work, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And how she's been engineered still baffles me... It's as if her AI or machine learning algorithm has figured out how we want others to feel...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, Robo-Nene, let's keep this up tomorrow too.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Roger!
The final day - Afternoon

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Costume, check! Props, check! Robo-Nene, check...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Today's the day when Ms. Kazamatsuri's supposed to come see our show...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm getting nervous already...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I want her to feel what I did when I first saw her sing all those years ago...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, this is it! Our final performance! Let's go out with a real bang!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The show must go on until the very end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then here we go!
Let's make this show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Beach Stage

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I made it in time.  Looks like the first few rows are for children only, so this seat should do nicely...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Sitting in an amphitheater like this really takes me back...)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: We will now be having a special showing of The Adventures of the Merprince and Little Mermaids.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The Adventures of the Merprince and the Little Mermaids? Hehe. Sound interesting!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Sister!!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: Big sis!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Huh?! W-Wait...!
Didn't I tell you not to barge into my coral reef like that?! I'm busy nap... Getting in some beauty sleep!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Forget that! Just look at this book, will you?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What the...? The Little Mermaid...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (So they took the Little Mermaid and turned into a clever little mermaid adventure... It's very easy to pick up too.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Geez...
Do I really have to drink this thing...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: The surface world's supposed to be really dull, right?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Still, seeing what city life, parties, castles and stuff are like might be a little fun...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But I'm still scared of wandering around such a strange place.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I want to try something new and interesting.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Trying something new and interesting, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (I used to be the same way. Even now, after I found the spotlight, I decided to go abroad...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (I had my ups and downs, but I don't regret making that decision.)

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: Finally, we made it to a human settlement!

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line:
This is what they call a 'city'?
There's so many big buildings!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we have to keep drinking these potions every hour to keep our legs, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So far so good!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I exit the stage after some games catch my eye, and lose track of where my brother and sister are in the process.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They get captured by Rui, now the bad guy, and I decide to drink the potion after hearing them scream to turn into Robo-Nene...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Where's Robo-Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She was right here just now...?!

rows.Speaker: Child's Voice
rows.Line:
N-No, stop!
Don't kick it! This robot's a good guy!

rows.Speaker: Child's Voice
rows.Line:
But look how strong it is!
It'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Is something going on backstage...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Violence is bad.
That is not happy.

rows.Speaker: Child B
rows.Line:
Hey, it's talking! Cool!
Maybe it can shoot rockets and stuff too!

rows.Speaker: Child C
rows.Line:
Oh, there's a weird-looking door!
Let's hit it!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... That compartment contains my circuit boards. Please, do not hit it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Children B & C
rows.Line: Busted! Run!

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to apologize. You were the one that was trying to stop them, right? Still, what happened here...?

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: I started crying after I tripped and fell, but this robot came to help...

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: Then those other kids came along and started hitting it for fun...

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: But I couldn't stop them! I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, really, it's okay.
Thank you for protecting Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But... What do I do?
Recharging her won't really fix this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The climax where I transform into Robo-Nene won't be the same without her...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nene...?
What are you doing there? You're almost up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...! Robo-Nene, she's...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nothing...
Some connectors just came loose, so just give me a few minutes to reconnect them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the Robo-Nene scene is also coming up. I'll need you to buy me some time while I fix her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, Tsukasa and Emu are captives, so there isn't much they can do in terms of improvising...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Improvise...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And Rui's gonna be busy fixing Robo-Nene, so that means I'm the only one that can do anything about this.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But what am I supposed to do?
I'm not very good at ad-libbing like everybody else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, now's not the time for that...!
I need to do whatever I can right now!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't want our audience to go home disappointed!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to do everything I can to make sure our show makes them all smile and laugh!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Rui...
I'll try...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll try to buy as much time as I can for you, so please, fix Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're the only one here who can fix her, Rui, and the other two are still on stage, so they have no idea what's going on back here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So it's all up to me... I'll do what I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, understood...
Good luck, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line: No, how did we let the humans capture us...?

rows.Speaker: Littler Mermaid
rows.Line: What do we do?! What do we do?!

rows.Speaker: Merprince
rows.Line:
We need to find a way to escape...!
I know! Let's head towards that window and see if we can get out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
That was Nene's cue to appear...
Where is she...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait, could she be in trouble...?!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Oh no, they got caught!! What do I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Ah, there she is!
Now to slowly exit the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What's Robo-Nene doing back here? Isn't her scene coming up really soon...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sadly, she ran into a bit of trouble. Some children decided to play rough with her, which caused her to malfunction.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
C-Can you fix her?!
Without Robo-Nene, the final scene won't...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene promised to buy me some time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll keep doing what I can here, so please help her as best you can, both of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okie-dokie!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
B-But what should we do?!
We're not supposed to go back out until after Nene's scene. If we go now, it'll ruin the whole story...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... The next scene is where Nene transforms after drinking the strange potion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how can we help her during all that...?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What do I do...? There's no way I can save them both...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Normally, this is when I'm supposed to drink my potion and save them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I need to keep stalling until Robo-Nene's back on her feet...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No! You know what, I don't care about what happens to those two.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I kept telling them that going anywhere near these humans was really dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I got to see and experience so many new things because of them too.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: And not all humans are bad. The food they make is really good...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: And because of them...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Mommy, what's gonna happen to the merprince?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Save them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's just a little bit, but I think I managed to buy us some time.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, I can't keep making the audience run around in circles like this. What else can I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh...!
Ms. Kazamatsuri...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What would she do at a time like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I were in her shoes when she was the Little Mermaid all those years ago...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: 'I'm going! I need to see him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That's it...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just have to sing!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: The thought of standing up against humans terrifies me. Just thinking about all the terrible things that could happen to me because of that scares me so much...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: But I can't just leave them behind...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I have to muster up as much courage as I can.

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I need to be brave like the Little Mermaid when she decided to go ashore...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
Nene's singing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! But there aren't any singing scenes in this show!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: Whoa...! Such a beautiful song...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She's ad-libbing a whole song...?!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The melody and lyrics are a little different, but this sounds just like...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: It's like when I sang as the Little Mermaid...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There! She's back online!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you feel ready to go on stage?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Yes, I am ready!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, please let Nene know that we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene!
Robo-Nene's all fixed up!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Okay, I feel much better. Now I need to go and save them somehow...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait, I know! I still have that weird potion! The one for when we get into really big trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Please, I need a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: I don't care if I dissolve into foam like the Little Mermaid in the book...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Wait... Huh?
Wh-What just happened to me?!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that right now... I have to figure out a way to save them...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez...
I thought my heart was literally going to explode...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, that was super duper extra wonderhoy!! Your song was really really wonderhoy too!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, don't scare me like that. You're gonna shorten my lifespan even more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I agree with Emu. Nicely done with those improvisations, Nene! Your song was wonderful too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
You kept the scene and story afloat despite the intense pressure. We couldn't have asked for more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene.
You gave our audience a wonderful reason to smile.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It was nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, you should be proud of what you just did. You looked at the situation and did whatever you could as an actress for your audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You became a really twinkly star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... I don't like relinquishing my throne, but today, you've earned it! You're the MVP!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Nene, that was great...
Mind if we have a word?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Kazamatsuri...!
You came all the way back here to see us...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, is she the one?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
She still has that same aura about her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to come and visit!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure. I should be thanking you for putting on such a wonderful show. Actually, that's what I'd like to discuss with you if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Oh, but... I still have to clean up...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's okay, Nene! We'll take care of that, so talk as much as you like♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, go! We insist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should be able to wrap things up there, so please, don't hesitate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I apologize for dropping in unannounced like that.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we? How about we head towards the beach and get out of your friends' hair?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Thank you for being so considerate!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... H-How did you like our show?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It absolutely blew me away!
Thank you for inviting me to see it, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: From start to finish, each scene was full of excitement, but... My favorite part had to be when you sang for us, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The way you sang really sent me back in time to when I was much younger.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you were younger?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes... I was exposed to theatre for the very first time in high school and never felt the sort of exhilaration that shows can give you until then.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I moved to Tokyo right after I graduated to pursue a career in acting...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But it took me a very long time to make that decision. I was so scared of diving into a world that was completely unknown to me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
But as scared as I was...
I took the leap, and you reminded me of how I was able to muster up the courage to do so, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I didn't expect to hear the word scared come out of your mouth...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're a globetrotting celebrity, so I was under the impression that you were fearless.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really not as strong as you say I am. I get nervous before the curtains go up just like anybody else.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I think it just has to do with how my desire to perform in shows all around the world usually wins in the end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about that...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really want to know more about what it's been like for you doing shows all over the world...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but... I know you're a very busy person, so I won't keep you if you don't have time to...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Haha! I'd be more than happy to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: After The Little Mermaid became a success, I stayed in Japan and kept honing my craft.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But as time went on, my desire to be a part of bigger and better things led me to move to the United States...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That was also a very rough time for me. Not a day went by when I didn't feel discouraged in some way...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I've seen some videos of your U.S. performances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Based on what I saw, it seemed like nothing was bothering you at all. You looked confident...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I may've looked that way, but I struggled with my English. Even though I studied as hard as I could, the language barrier between me and my colleagues led to some trouble.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I couldn't get any of my points across to them. But at the same time, I didn't want to give up after coming so far...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I practiced singing and dancing harder than anyone else, and even worked on my improvisation skills...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I ran headfirst into that language barrier and felt the culture shock of being in a completely new world...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But success never felt sweeter when I did figure things out in the end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Her eyes are sparkling.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That must've been a really incredible show...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really?! Theatre's doing that well abroad...?!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: To be fair, these other countries have so many theaters to start, as well as so many actors with an unimaginably wide range of personalities.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: When I went to India to study traditional dances there, I thought my body was going to give out because of how hard I had to work.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But it felt so great when I did learn to do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's like one of those globetrotting actresses you see in the movies...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It must be scary to travel to all these different places to do shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But really exciting at the same time...
Singing and dancing while the whole world watches...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her life sounds like so much fun. Maybe someday, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, we'll...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Looking back, I've been able to visit so many different places...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I wouldn't have been able to do that without the help of all those who were there to support me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'm here today because of my friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your friends?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Yes.
I actually started out in a very small troupe.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It didn't even have ten people.
But they were kind enough to take in a novice like me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Most others laughed at me when I told them about how I wanted to do shows around the world, but this troupe didn't.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They seem like really nice people...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: They were.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Which is why leaving them was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I ask what happened to that troupe...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: They're still around. But some left for greener pastures like I did, and the next generation seems to be running the show now.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Everybody's chasing after their own dreams and doing what they can to make them come true. It's nice but also makes me sad sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I really loved being in shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I want to perform in shows while traveling around the world, that means...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We won't be together...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I don't regret my decision.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I've been able to achieve my dreams and learn to love doing shows because they were there to support me...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Relationships may come and go, but wonderful shows are born in the process...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Saying goodbye is a very sad thing, but that's not the whole story. There's just as much joy hiding behind that sadness.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: So please, Nene, keep trying your best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I will...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming today. I'll be looking forward to your show.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You're welcome, and thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Travel around the world and make people smile by putting on shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That kind of life would be amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But that means someday, I have to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't see myself doing that...
<Is everything okay, Nene...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Who's there...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's me...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, it's you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That reminds me... I completely forgot about promising to show you the beach. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Don't mind me.
I've actually been taking peeks here and there in secret♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have? Who knows what'll happen if you get caught.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... There aren't that many people around right now, so why don't we take a quick stroll before meeting back up with the others?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You'd do that? Thank you, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.
Beach

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The sea's so beautiful and calm at night. There are so many stars out tonight too...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
They really are beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Um, Nene...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I overheard a part of the conversation you just had with that actress.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You two seemed to be having so much fun together, so I got a little curious... I apologize for eavesdropping like that.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's okay. You don't need to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Her stories were so interesting, weren't they? Visiting all those places, performing shows everywhere and meeting so many different people...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It must be a lot of fun being able to do shows like that.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Which is why leaving them was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But if it means making my dreams come true...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Um, Nene?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Are you wondering if you have to leave your friends someday to make your dreams come true?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After listening to Ms. Kazamatsuri's stories, I'm wondering if I'll have to make that same choice one day...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I can't see myself leaving everyone to pursue a different goal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I convinced myself somewhere along the way that we'll keep doing this forever or something...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was a hard pill to swallow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have our own dreams that we want to come true and work hard every day to make them happen.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we inevitably might have to go our separate ways someday...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I see. You may have no choice if you're all pursuing different dreams...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry...
I can't say for sure what would be best for you, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, please, don't apologize.
It's my fault for bringing this up...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I want you to be the one to figure out what's truly best for you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And I'll do whatever I can to help you find that answer.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Luka's such a nice person...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't have to do this alone.
That's what she wanted me to know.)

rows.Line: Neneee!!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That voice... Eep!
Emu?

rows.Line: Don't forget us, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, the gang's all here.>

rows.Line:
Hey, it's Luka!
Good evening!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you guys still doing here? I thought you were heading back to the hotel once you finished cleaning up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. We have some good news, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Good news!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good news?

rows.Line: All the advance tickets for Phoenix Wonderland we came here to promote just sold out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Already?

rows.Line: Yes! It's only natural considering how great our performances were! Hah hah hah!!

rows.Line: To celebrate us taking our first big steps as ambassadors, we were thinking about doing this.

rows.Line: These are... Fireworks?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where did you get these?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu found a shop nearby that was selling them.

rows.Line: We have to head back home tomorrow, so this is really our only chance to do something like this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Sparkle-sparkle-BOOM!!

rows.Line: I don't have a problem with Sparkle-sparkle, Emu, but no BOOM, okay?

rows.Line:
Agreed.
No need to put ourselves in harm's way.

Really, Rui? You of all people...?

...
